verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit ships an official CLI, and its docs explicitly say reviews can run in CI/CD pipelines and be triggered by coding agents such as Claude Code without manual intervention. Reviews also run automatically on pull requests, configured through `reviews.auto_review`. The CI claim rests on a single overview sentence, though, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed CI setup docs (non-interactive flags, headless auth/tokens, machine-readable output, exit codes) and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: integrate seamlessly with your AI coding agents, or run reviews in CI/CD pipelines.
Claude Code can trigger CodeRabbit reviews directly through simple commands, enabling you to build features, run code reviews, and fix issues without manual intervention.
Get AI code reviews directly in your CLI before you commit.
Configure when and how CodeRabbit automatically reviews pull requests using the `reviews.auto_review` settings.
